description: The full text of one section (§ or artikkel) of a current Norwegian law or regulation, with the ids of the previous and next section. Costs 0.005 USDC per successful call (x402, Base). Errors are free.

id.description: Lovdata id, e.g. lov/2005-06-17-62 (a law) or forskrift/2010-01-29-72 (a regulation). Put it in the path as written, slash included.

section.description: Section id as listed in the table of contents: § 3-1, URL-encoded, or just 3-1.

name: get_law_section
title: Get one section of a law or regulation
